preconditions: The app is foregrounded on the locked chart's band-confirmation screen.
Auto Live is visibly ON with ten remaining Auto Live uses.
The Live Boost display visibly shows 10 -> 9.
Deck 1 is selected and no member, card, skill, account, or display identity is exported.
SELinux is Enforcing and Frida uses explicit 127.0.0.1:47913 forwarding.

observation_contract.input_injection: one predeclared Android adb tap followed by wait only

allowed: numeric skill duration, once-effect, trigger-condition, and active-effect rows
anonymous skill queue state and Float32 timer bits
judgement, score, life, and correction numeric values
forbidden: music, member, card, or skill display strings

promotion_requirements: The capture has no error and sequence numbers are contiguous.
Initialization observes maxNoteCount 979 and Auto Live mode.
At least two anonymous skill aliases initialize and at least two skill transitions complete.
Every exported skill profile excludes forbidden identity fields and raw pointers.
One-note max observations contain no notesType strings and demonstrate at least one positive-score update.
No return replacement, memory write, managed invocation, APK modification, Continue, or premium-currency operation occurs.
